item.title: Argenica Study Confirms Compatibility of ARG-007 Candidate with Stroke Treatment Standard-of-Care Therapies
item.description: Argenica Therapeutics (ASX: AGN) has reported positive results from a drug-to-drug interaction assessment showing its lead candidate ARG-007 does not interfere with clot-dissolving agent tenecteplase in the treatment of acute ischemic stroke.

item.title: Ballymore Resources Confirms Exceptional Polymetallic Grades at Torpy’s Prospect
item.description: Ballymore Resources (ASX: BMR) has reported exceptional high-grade silver, lead, zinc, and indium mineralisation from the first reverse circulation drilling at the Torpy’s prospect within its Ruddygore Project in North Queensland.

item.title: St George Mining Working Hard in Brazil to Earn Local Support for Araxá Project
item.description: St George Mining (ASX: SGQ) continues to receive strong local backing for its proposed development of the Araxá project in Brazil, with more than 200 stakeholders attending an open day and critical minerals forum the company recently hosted in Minas Gerais.

item.title: OMG Group Reports Record Online and In-Store Sales for November Across Multi-Brand Portfolio
item.description: Health-focused food products company OMG Group (ASX: OMG) has reported record sales for November from its multi-brand portfolio across physical store distribution networks and e-commerce channels.

item.title: Algorae Pharmaceuticals Achieves Independent Validation of AlgoraeOS and Launches Enhanced v2 Platform
item.description: Algorae Pharmaceuticals (ASX: 1AI) has reported independent preclinical validation of its AlgoraeOS v1 drug-combination prediction platform following a major study at the Victorian Centre for Functional Genomics at the Peter MacCallum Cancer Centre.

item.title: Mithril Silver and Gold Adds to Mexican Portfolio with Option over La Dura Concessions
item.description: Mithril Silver and Gold (ASX: MTH) is making a strategic move to build on its Mexican precious metals plans with potential acquisition of the La Dura project covering a total area of 2,052 hectares in Durango state

item.title: Askari Metals Secures Strategic Funding to Launch Maiden Drilling at Nejo Copper-Gold Project
item.description: Askari Metals (ASX: AS2) has secured firm commitments of A$1.15 million from new and existing sophisticated investors to fund its maiden drilling program at the advanced-stage Nejo copper and gold project in Ethiopia.

item.title: Critical Resources Updates Amoco Gold-Antimony Project as Cap Burn Acquisition Finalised
item.description: Critical Resources Limited (ASX: CRR) has confirmed that maiden drilling at its Amoco gold-antimony project in NSW has defined a substantial mineralised orogenic system, just a day after completing its acquisition of the Cap Burn gold project in New Zealand.

item.title: Sparc Technologies Achieves Key Hydrogen Milestone as Roseworthy Pilot Plant Enters Operational Testing
item.description: Sparc Technologies (ASX: SPN) has achieved sustained hydrogen generation at its first-of-its-kind green hydrogen pilot plant in Roseworthy, South Australia, marking the transition to full operational testing under concentrated solar conditions.

item.title: Weekly Wrap: Market Higher For A Second Week
item.description: Australian shares were up slightly for a second week on Friday with investors hoping for an interest rate cut in the US, even as the chances of a local cut have evaporated. With the US Fed and the local Reserve Bank both meeting this week to decide on official interest rates, there are still strong hopes the US will cut rate even though still strong Australian inflation have greatly reduced the chances of any cut here.
